column2: 101 event/lead rows and 24 linked workout records retained. This deeper pass adds three analytical schedules, updates eight existing cases, corrects Palisades loss scope and dates the 650 Madison cure precisely. No new event rows.
All original rows reviewed structurally. Only rows with source URLs were externally checked; unverified leads remain clearly labeled. No claim that every field of a sourced row is verified.
A selected event collection, not a representative market sample. Do not treat its mean discount or growing row count as average CRE losses or the rate of deterioration.
Property ID links events for the same property. Event ID is unique per record. Duplicate leads and summary rows are explicitly excluded from sale analysis.

Column D contains reported completed property consideration, creditor auction bids, deed-in-lieu consideration or note-sale consideration. Read Amount Type, Event Type and Include flag before comparison. These categories are not interchangeable.

Column AQ holds asking prices, starting bids, failed offers and court-approved proposed consideration. These do not populate completed disposition amounts or calculated discounts. Reported auction bids in D remain explicitly labeled and excluded until eligibility is verified.
Columns E and AA–AB identify the amount, type and year. Prior purchases, appraisals, assessments, recapitalization valuations and debt must not be pooled as one measure.

Column F = 1 − disposition amount / benchmark amount when both are numeric and the benchmark is positive. Negative values mean a gross price increase. The result is not total investment return or creditor loss.
Columns AS–AU preserve a separate alternative comparison (for example Plaza 600’s 2012 purchase versus its 2019 recapitalization). Do not add the two discounts together.

Yes = a sourced completed property sale. Unverified = a lead requiring verification. No = non-sale, creditor bid, debt resolution, lender transfer, pending/failed event, excluded duplicate/summary, missing price, or auction result without verified closing.

Start with Include = Yes; then require the same benchmark type, ownership interest, currency and asset scope, and a verified benchmark. A Yes flag does not by itself certify the benchmark or comparability.

Columns AG–AJ separate debt principal, reported realized credit loss, distributable principal recovery, and credit-loss status. Do not calculate bank losses from property prices or infer retained exposure from loan originators.

Centre Square remains pending/unconfirmed; its loss expectations are not realized amounts. 1740 Broadway, Palisades and 3000 Post Oak have separately sourced credit-loss records with different verification levels.

Event Date is populated only when a specific date is supported. A scheduled auction date is labeled scheduled. Month/year-only evidence stays in Context / Date and Sale / Status Year; no invented first-of-month closing dates.
Source Publication Date refers to the principal cited report. Last Source Check is 2026-09-30 for externally checked rows; it does not assert a current servicer or deed search for every field.

Prefer recorded instruments, court filings, SEC filings, servicer/remittance records and rating-agency loss reports for the relevant facts; use transaction-party releases and original reporting as appropriate. Social posts are leads, not authoritative evidence.
AK–AM hold direct URLs; Review Notes identify scope and unresolved items. Paywalled excerpts support only visible claims. Corroborated reporting is distinct from primary transaction/credit evidence.

Original N–P raw price/decline text is unchanged for every original row. Original Workbook Row maps records to the supplied workbook. Conflicting old claims remain there for auditability, not as endorsed facts.

Exact, unambiguous prices already present in original text were copied into numeric fields; this extraction does not verify them. Ranges, upper bounds and uncertain amounts remain in text. Original price precision is not evidence of appraisal precision.
USD unless otherwise stated. The Calgary lead’s currency remains unconfirmed and must not be aggregated with USD. No FX conversion is applied.

Discount cells: red ≥85%, yellow 50% to <85%, green ≤0%. Blue status cells indicate exclusion from sale analysis. Amber verification cells flag selected unverified leads, duplicate leads and inference/confirmation gaps. Colors are descriptive, not risk scores.

Original row 21 is a probable duplicate of 24. Row 29 is an auction stage superseded by row 30’s reported completed deal. Rows 11 and 16 are overlapping summaries. None counts as a separate completed sale.

Identified anonymous Denver, Chicago, New York and St. Louis properties; corrected American Bank’s year, One Lincoln’s benchmark, 70 W. Madison’s closing price, and Hartford’s listing status. Source-backed amount refinements are documented per row.

410 Townsend has separate 2024 and 2026 events. Price increases and recovery/repositioning cases remain visible alongside distress cases. Capex and net cash flows are needed before estimating investment returns.
